correctness.rationale: For every c>=2 except 4 and every nonzero integral conic point, source quotient formulas z1=cx+y+c, z2=cz1+x+c, z3=cz2+z1-c, z4=cz3+z2-c obey P0(x)=y z1, P1(z1)=x z2, P2(z2)=z1 z3, P3(z3)=z2 z4 on C=x^2-y^2+c(x-y)+c-cxy=0, and (z4,z3) preserves C. Independent SymPy exact division verifies all four identities are +/-C and return conic is C. Nonzero quotients follow because c(c-4) and c(c+4) cannot be nonzero-square discriminants of P0,P2 or P1,P3: factor pairs of 4 of same parity force c=4 or c=0 respectively. Induction proves indefinite continuation for c!=4. At c=4 point (-2,4) lies on C and z1=0. No positivity/coprimality hypothesis used.
